name: Indiana Rubber & Plastic, LLC
old_description: We specialize in custom molded plastics and rubber. We offer turnkey service from idea to prototypes to volume production with custom molding and low-cost alternatives.
about:
Indiana Rubber & Plastic, LLC has operated from Indianapolis, Indiana since 1936. The company specializes in custom molded plastics and rubber, offering turnkey service from concept through prototype to volume production.

Its capabilities span prototyping via 3D printing, SLA, rapid molding, and silicone molds; rubber molding through compression, transfer, injection, and LSR/LIM processes; plastic injection molding; die cutting; extrusion of both plastics and rubber; lathe-cut rubber; machined plastics; and bonded rubber-to-metal components. The facility handles prototypes of 1–50 pieces, short runs of 1–5,000 pieces, medium runs of 5,000–25,000 pieces, and high-volume orders exceeding 25,000 pieces, with high-tonnage, large-platen presses for oversized parts. On-site tooling and proprietary low-cost Tool$aver® methods support quick-turn tooling.

The company works with a broad material portfolio including silicone, EPDM, Viton, nitrile, neoprene, fluorosilicone, and other rubber compounds, as well as engineering plastics such as PEEK, polycarbonate, nylon, ABS, and thermoplastic elastomers. It produces grommets, gaskets, seals, bumpers, diaphragms, bushings, extrusions, mounts, formed hoses, boots, and washers/spacers for customers requiring food-grade and military-specification materials.

Indiana Rubber & Plastic emphasizes three generations of experience, in-house design, chemistry, and laboratory resources, and a commitment to keeping projects “in network” by leveraging established supplier relationships. The firm highlights communication throughout the supply cycle—from inquiry through tooling, production, and shipment—as a core differentiator.
